shaniwar_wada.name: Shaniwar Wada
shaniwar_wada.price_text: ≈ INR 25 for Indian visitors; higher for foreign visitors — check on the day
shaniwar_wada.tip: Come early morning to beat the heat and crowds. The light-and-sound show in the evening tells the fort's story.

aga_khan_palace.name: Aga Khan Palace
aga_khan_palace.price_text: ≈ INR 25 for Indian visitors; higher for foreign visitors — check on the day
aga_khan_palace.hours: Roughly 09:00–17:30 daily; closed timings vary, check on the day
aga_khan_palace.tip: Gandhi was interned here; the memorial and archives are the highlight. Allow time for the calm gardens.

mandai_market.name: Mandai Market
mandai_market.price_text: Free to browse; pay per item
mandai_market.hours: Morning to early evening; busiest in the morning
mandai_market.tip: Go in the morning for fresh produce and flowers. Keep bags close in the crowd.

laxmi_road.name: Laxmi Road shopping walk
laxmi_road.price_text: Free to walk; pay per purchase
laxmi_road.hours: Shops roughly 10:00–21:00; many close one day a week
laxmi_road.tip: Best for saris, jewellery and street snacks. Bargain politely and go on a weekday.

parvati_hill.name: Parvati Hill temples and viewpoint
parvati_hill.price_text: Free; small camera fee may apply
parvati_hill.tip: Climb the steps early for a city view and cooler air. Remove shoes at the temples.

dashabhuja_ganpati.name: Dashabhuja Ganpati, Kelkar Museum area walk
dashabhuja_ganpati.price_text: Free to walk; museum entry separate
dashabhuja_ganpati.tip: A short old-city walk past temples and lanes. Pair it with the Raja Dinkar Kelkar Museum nearby.

kelkar_museum.name: Raja Dinkar Kelkar Museum
kelkar_museum.tip: A quirky collection of everyday Indian objects. Allow an hour and check if photography is allowed.
kelkar_museum.best: Any time; good for hot afternoons

koregaon_park.name: Koregaon Park cafe and lane walk
koregaon_park.price_text: Free to walk; pay per meal
koregaon_park.tip: Leafy lanes full of cafes and boutiques. Good for a relaxed afternoon and dinner.

osho_garden.name: Osho Garden / meditation resort area
osho_garden.price_text: Public garden free; resort entry has its own rules — check ahead
osho_garden.tip: The public garden is a quiet green break. The meditation resort needs advance booking and a health check.

dagadusheth.name: Dagadusheth Halwai Ganpati Temple
dagadusheth.hours: Roughly 06:00–22:00; very busy at festival time
dagadusheth.tip: One of Pune's most loved temples. Dress modestly and expect queues during Ganesh Chaturthi.

saras_baug.name: Saras Baug garden
saras_baug.tip: A central green space with a temple on the hill. Good for a morning walk with locals.

fc_road.name: FC Road food and shopping stroll
fc_road.price_text: Free to walk; pay per item
fc_road.tip: Student hangout with cheap eats and bookshops. Try local snacks in the evening.

pataleshwar.name: Pataleshwar Cave Temple
pataleshwar.tip: A small rock-cut temple in the city. Quiet and quick to visit; remove shoes.

empress_garden.name: Empress Garden
empress_garden.tip: Large old botanical garden. Bring water and go early; some paths are uneven.

pune_food_tour.name: Pune street food tasting walk
pune_food_tour.price_text: ≈ INR 800–1500 per person — check operator prices
pune_food_tour.tip: Try misal, vada pav and puran poli. Confirm what is included and mention allergies when booking.

sinhgad_fort.name: Sinhagad Fort day trip
sinhgad_fort.tip: A hill fort about an hour from the city. Wear grippy shoes and try the local curd and jaggery snack.

vetal_hill.name: Vetal Hill viewpoint walk
vetal_hill.tip: A short climb for a city view. Go early morning and carry water.

phoenix_mall.name: Phoenix Marketcity Viman Nagar
phoenix_mall.price_text: Free to enter; pay per purchase
phoenix_mall.tip: Good for hot afternoons, food and shopping near the airport. Check show times if you want a film.

khadakwasla.name: Khadakwasla Dam lakeside
khadakwasla.tip: A calm lakeside escape on the city edge. Go in the cooler months and arrange your ride back.

pune_heritage_walk.name: Old Pune heritage walking tour
pune_heritage_walk.price_text: ≈ INR 500–1200 per person — check operator prices
pune_heritage_walk.tip: A guided walk links the old city's temples, lanes and history. Book a day ahead and wear comfortable shoes.
